title: ACL Deficient Gait
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: A finding that is present in a minority should not be taught as the characteristic pattern, and this one routinely is.
Avoid teaching quadriceps avoidance as the characteristic pattern, since it is present in a minority.
Assess the knee in a demanding task rather than in walking, because walking rarely provokes the deficit.
Expect gait abnormality and examination laxity to disagree, and say which you are describing.
Expect quadriceps deficit to persist for years and measure it rather than assume recovery.
Treat persistent altered kinematics as the mechanical candidate for later degeneration when counselling.
Avoid teaching quadriceps avoidance as characteristic.

Weigh the patient's age, physiology, comorbidities, knee demand, psychological state and their own ideas, concerns and expectations, because fear of reinjury changes gait and is part of the clinical picture rather than separate from it.
